card.name: Inside abbreviations like ONJ and GnRH
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the middle letter of a medical abbreviation or word that is still being spelled out, mainly the J in ONJ and the RH in GnRH. It also fires on a few closing punctuation marks and linking words.

modes.label: Inside ONJ
modes.description: The letter J completing the abbreviation for osteonecrosis of the jaw.
modes.example: For patients requiring dental procedures, there are no data available to suggest whether discontinuation of bisphosphonate treatment reduces the risk of ON<<J>>.

modes.label: Inside GnRH
modes.description: The RH piece of the hormone abbreviation GnRH, after Gn.
modes.example: Patients receiving TALZENNA and enzalutamide should also receive a gonadotropin-releasing hormone (Gn<<RH>>) analog concurrently

modes.label: Other partial terms
modes.description: A middle piece of a long medical word or a period closing a plant name citation.
modes.example: Experience with thyroidectomy as a treatment for amiodarone-induced thy<<ro>>toxicosis is limited
